subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Should maintainers close or ignore the conflicting fork PR and queue a fresh upstream Control UI fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the only open closing-reference PR is outside the target repository, conflicts, and targets the old executor path, so automation should not silently create competing work without maintainer routing intent.

options.title: Queue fresh upstream fix
options.body: Close or ignore the fork PR as non-viable for upstream and promote a narrow current-main fix with tests and UI proof.

options.title: Ask fork author to refresh upstream
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the fork author opening a clean upstream PR against the current `ui/src/pages/chat` path.

options.title: Hold for maintainer-owned repair
options.body: Keep the issue open without a repair job until a maintainer chooses the exact command semantics and branch owner.

recommendation.title: Queue fresh upstream fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the fork PR as non-viable for upstream and promote a narrow current-main fix with tests and UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and merge metadata connect this account to model-command path fixes and the current path merge.
